learning_objective: Master core Java syntax, control structures, primitive data types, and fundamental object manipulation without framework abstractions.

subtopics.name: Variables and Data Types
subtopics.description: Primitives (int, double, boolean, char, byte, short, long, float) vs Reference Types. Memory layout (Stack vs Heap).

subtopics.name: Operators
subtopics.description: Arithmetic (+, -, *, /, %), Relational (==, !=, >, <), Logical (&&, ||, !), Bitwise (&, |, ^), and Assignment operators.

subtopics.name: Control Flow - Conditionals
subtopics.description: Branching execution paths using if, else if, else, and switch statements (including traditional and modern switch expressions).

subtopics.name: Control Flow - Loops
subtopics.description: Iterative execution using standard for loops, enhanced for-each loops, while loops, and do-while loops with break/continue control.

subtopics.name: Methods
subtopics.description: Modularizing code into functions, parameter passing (pass-by-value in Java), return types, static vs instance methods, and method overloading.

subtopics.name: Arrays
subtopics.description: Fixed-size, contiguous memory data structures. Single-dimensional and multi-dimensional arrays, indexing, iteration, and common array manipulation.
subtopics.algorithms_and_logic: Linear Traversal, Array Inversion, Finding Max/Min elements.

subtopics.name: Strings & StringBuilder
subtopics.description: String immutability, String Pool memory management, string operations vs mutable string manipulation using StringBuilder for performance optimization.

subtopics.name: Type Casting
subtopics.description: Implicit conversion (widening: byte -> short -> int -> long -> float -> double) and Explicit conversion (narrowing) with potential truncation.

subtopics.name: Input/Output
subtopics.description: Reading console input using java.util.Scanner and outputting data via System.out methods.

subtopics.name: Basic Debugging
subtopics.description: Reading stack traces, identifying common runtime exceptions (NullPointerException, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException), and using print-debugging or IDE breakpoints.

practical_projects.description: Console application that takes two numbers and an operator, executing mathematical calculations using methods and control statements.
Generates a random integer between 1 and 100, prompting the user for guesses and giving 'higher/lower' feedback inside a loop until correct.
Checks if a string is identical forwards and backwards, ignoring non-alphanumeric characters and casing.
practical_projects.algorithm: Two-Pointer Strategy: O(N) Time, O(1) Auxiliary Space

practical_projects.description: Determines whether a given integer is a prime number.
practical_projects.algorithm: Trial Division up to Square Root of N: O(sqrt(N)) Time, O(1) Space

practical_projects.description: Utility program performing essential array transformations without using high-level framework structures.
practical_projects.algorithm: In-Place Array Reversal: O(N) Time, O(1) Space

practical_projects.description: Detects if two strings contain the exact same characters in different arrangements.
practical_projects.algorithm: Frequency Array Counter: O(N) Time, O(1) Space (assuming 256 ASCII characters)
